notes.title: An alternate version with new music was added!
notes.notes:
The game has been out on the Nintendo Switch for a while, and that version had an alternate soundtrack. Now you can also experience these new tracks in the new alternate version!

Note that this new version's runtime has been updated (a major thing -- but everything seems to work fine so far), and it also features an easy mode, which can be accessed at a sign in the first area of the game.
